name: Kifly
description:
Kifly connects Claude to a network of independent sellers so your agent can shop and complete real purchases end to end.

With Kifly, Claude can:
- Search the seller network with multilingual semantic search (100+ languages), filtered by category, price range, and stock.
- Inspect a seller's profile, flat delivery fee, and delivery coverage before buying.
- Build a single-seller cart, adjust quantities, and validate a shipping address against the seller's coverage area.
- Check out,Kifly returns a secure Stripe Checkout link to complete payment, then reports order and shipment status.
- Optionally register a reusable buyer profile so repeat purchases skip manual data entry.

Each cart is bound to one seller. Kifly never custodies funds: payment is processed by Stripe and settled directly to the seller. Authentication is via OAuth, and your agent is granted only the scopes it needs; catalog read, cart and checkout write, and order read.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Kifly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Kifly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://kifly.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Kifly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kifly lists 18 MCP tools, including add_to_cart, checkout, create_cart, get_buyer_profile, get_cart, get_help, get_platform_limits, get_seller, list_sellers, order_status, register_buyer, and request_buyer_code.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Kifly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Kifly in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Kifly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Kifly is developed by Kifly, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
